neighbours.label: the token ' both' (also 'Both')
fire: The charger works with both phones and tablets without any adapter.
On both sides of the river there are old stone warehouses.
The course teaches both grammar and conversation in the same week.
My parents both grew up in small fishing towns on the coast.
The jacket is suitable for both summer and winter hikes.
Tickets are valid on both buses and trams across the city.
The study found that both groups improved after six weeks.
You can pay in both euros and dollars at the border shop.
quiet: The charger works with phones but not with tablets or watches.
On one side of the river there are old stone warehouses.
The course teaches grammar and then conversation the following week.
My parents each grew up in small fishing towns on the coast.
The jacket is suitable for summer hikes in the hills.
Tickets are valid on either buses or trams across the city.
The study found that each group improved after six weeks.
You can pay in euros or dollars at the border shop.

notes: ' both' is 29 of top 32. - pole: 'same' / 'just like' (similarity).
